summary: Iteration 547 — Backend fully passing (16/16 pytest). Frontend: CloudbedsPanel works end-to-end (MOCK badge, push with 14-day sample intervals, pull MOCK toast). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: SimulatorPanel.js crashes in ErrorBoundary with 'measureElasticity is not defined' as soon as the panel mounts — the new elasticity + branding sections reference handlers/state (measureElasticity, saveLogo, el, logoUrl, setLogoUrl) that were never added. This blocks all Simulator UI flows including elasticity, branding save, pitch-pdf link, plus previously working bid-price/replay/PDF.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: measureElasticity is not defined at line 98; also references undefined saveLogo, el, logoUrl, setLogoUrl. Missing useState hooks and handler functions. Entire Simulator panel throws into ErrorBoundary ('Bir şeyler ters gitti · Reference measureElasticity is not defined') — elasticity-btn, elasticity-results, branding-logo-input, branding-save-btn, sim-pitch-pdf-btn, sim-run-btn, bidprice-btn all inaccessible.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard/SimulatorPanel.js add missing state: const [el,setEl]=useState(null); const [logoUrl,setLogoUrl]=useState(''); and handlers measureElasticity (GET /api/elasticity/{pid}) and saveLogo (POST /api/simulator/{pid}/branding {logo_url}). Optionally preload branding on mount (GET /api/simulator/{pid}/branding). This restores Simulator + elasticity + pitch UI. Backend endpoints all confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: SimulatorPanel.js: undefined identifiers used in JSX (measureElasticity, saveLogo, el, logoUrl, setLogoUrl). No CI/lint step would have caught this at runtime since the panel is lazy-mounted; recommend enabling eslint no-undef in the build.

CloudbedsPanel: test-connection button (cb-test-btn) is only rendered when mode==='live', so the '400 without api_key' behaviour cannot be exercised from UI in MOCK mode — this is by design but worth documenting.

Cloudbeds is in Revenue & rates -> Market & Compset subgroup.
rca of the issue: SimulatorPanel.js was extended with new elasticity-section (lines 92-112) and branding-section (lines 113-121). The JSX references measureElasticity, saveLogo, el, logoUrl, setLogoUrl but the corresponding useState hooks and async handler functions were never added to the component (see lines 10-45 where only sim/rp/bp/busy state and runSim/loadBid/runReplay handlers exist). Runtime hits ReferenceError as soon as the component evaluates the onClick prop of elasticity-btn, throwing into ErrorBoundary (ERR-9S1XFTFP). Fix = add the two useState hooks + two async fetch handlers wired to /api/elasticity/{pid} and /api/simulator/{pid}/branding (backend already returns proper shapes).
